newsitem.title: UK: Liverpool cotton - Easier US futures stimulate inqui.
newsitem.headline: Liverpool cotton - Easier US futures stimulate inqui.

text.p: New York futures set the tone for most markets and a further decline in values there has served to stimulate more enquiry, particularly from Germany.
The growths in the limelight have been Central Asian and West African styles, both of which have been sought for shipments during the April through July period.
In Italy, in addition to those growths, attention focused on offers of Syrian descriptions following a visit by a sales delegation from Aleppo.
Many traders hold to the view that, in general, spinners still need substantial quantities of cotton to meet shipment requirements between now and the movement of the next northern hemisphere crops.
